validated_results.title: Meat intake, 'mate' drinking and renal cell cancer in Uruguay: a case-control study.
validated_results.reason: This hospital-based case-control study provides multivariable-adjusted odds ratios and 95% confidence intervals for the association between red meat intake and renal cell carcinoma risk.

extraction.population: Patients admitted to the Instituto Nacional de Oncologia in Montevideo, Uruguay

cases.excerpt: This led to a final total of 121 cases and 243 controls.

design.excerpt: In the period January 1988-December 1995, a case-control study of diet and renal cell carcinoma (RCC) risk involving 121 cases and 243 hospitalized controls was carried out in Montevideo, Uruguay.

timing.excerpt: From January 1988. all patients admitted to the Instituto Nacional de Oncologia were routinely interviewed shortly after admittance

exposure_measurement.excerpt: The food frequency questionnaire was short and focused on meat intake. As poultry and fish are infrequently consumed in Uruguay. no infor- mation about these items was collected.

smoking_status.excerpt: Adjusted for age, sex, residence, urban-rural status, education, body mass index and 'mate' drinking.

extraction.ethnicity_basis: NA: no field-specific ethnicity evidence was available

parallel_r3_gate_reasons: JBI remains Fair after Claude R2
